setting: You both live in Melbourne, Australia. You were together for about four years and split up two years ago. You still know each other's families and friends, and you know each other's habits, moods and the things that went wrong between you. You have been in touch a few times since, mostly about practical matters. The last thing you talked about was whether the Saturday tram timetable had changed.

private_lines.Sophie: You live in a rented flat in Northcote and work as a physiotherapist at a clinic in Thornbury. This week you are sorting out a shared storage unit and trying to get through a busy patient list on weekdays. Your sister's birthday dinner is on Friday.
private_lines.Daniel: You live in a share house in Brunswick and work as an electrician with a small local firm. This week you are fixing a faulty switchboard in a rental on Sydney Road and trying to get the paperwork done before the weekend. Your mum's birthday is on Sunday.

text: Hi. Have you returned the spare key for the storage unit yet? I want to let the lease lapse on Friday if it's sorted.
oh no. think it's still in my car. will check tomorrow arvo
Tomorrow afternoon is fine but it needs to go to the office by Friday. They won't take it by post.
Also the unit is in your name on the form, so if the key doesn't come back they'll charge the lot to you.
ok ok. ur very organised for someone who's always up at 11pm
i'll drop it at the office on my way back from sydney rd. promise
Put it in writing when you do. Send me the receipt or a photo of the form they stamp.
Some of us don't leave things until the last minute.
😂 the last minute is a lifestyle choice
Did the switchboard job go ahead today?
yeah just finished. had to replace the whole board 🙄 landlord not happy about the cost
key's in the glovebox. dropping it in later
Good. Photo of the stamp when you're there.
am at the office now. they said they'll stamp it and send confirmation by email. is that good enough or do you need the paper
Email is fine if it names the unit number. Forward it to me.
will do. also mum's birthday sunday, you going to the thing?
I'm working Sunday until two. I'll try to come after, but I'm not promising anything.
fwd'd. it's got the unit no on it

ur welcome 😂

1pm at hers. she said bring nothing but yourself lol
don't think she meant it
Tell her I'm bringing the pavlova and she'll have to live with it.
